title: Selling Evidence Bit by Bit
abstract: arXiv:2610.30563v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the sale of an asset to competitive buyers. Before the sale, the seller can buy hard information about the asset from an intermediary who designs and prices a test to maximize his revenue guarantee across equilibria. The test consists of one or more signals, and the seller privately chooses which subset of signals to buy and selectively discloses their realization to the buyers. We show that the intermediary benefits from splitting information into multiple signals and characterize his maximal revenue guarantee as the cumulative entropy of the asset value distribution. This guarantee is achieved by a sequence of ``skim from the top'' tests with binary, i.i.d.\ signals and additive pricing. Furthermore, any sequence of tests that achieves the maximal guarantee reveals the asset's value in the limit. translated_abstract: 我们研究将一项资产出售给竞争性买家的问题。在出售之前，卖方可以从中介那里购买关于该资产的硬信息，该中介通过设计测试并对其定价，以最大化其在所有均衡下的收入保证。该测试由一个或多个信号组成，卖方私下选择购买哪些信号子集，并有选择地向买家披露信号的实现结果。我们证明中介可以通过将信息拆分为多个信号而获益，并将其最大收入保证刻画为资产价值分布的累积熵。这一保证可通过一系列“自上而下抽取”的测试来实现，这些测试采用二元、独立同分布的信号和加性定价。此外，任何达到最大保证的测试序列在极限中都会揭示资产的真实价值。对于二元价值的情况，我们还刻画了任意给定信号数量下的收入保证，并证明它由某类测试实现。
tldr: 中介通过将资产信息拆分为多个二元信号逐份出售给卖方来实现收入保证最大化，该最大保证等于资产价值分布的累积熵，且最优测试序列在极限中会完全揭示资产价值。
en_tdlr: An intermediary maximizes its revenue guarantee by splitting information into multiple binary signals sold bit by bit to the seller, with the maximal guarantee equal to the cumulative entropy of the asset value distribution, and any optimal test sequence reveals the asset's value in the limit.
